dedupe_keys.name: estonian residential photovoltaic generation and electricity exchange

description: Tallinn University of Technology publishes electricity and photovoltaic measurements from one Estonian home during 2023. The house has 5-kW rooftop photovoltaics, a 4.2-kW three-phase inverter, a heat pump, an electric sauna and a 2.4-kW vehicle charger. Two power-quality loggers record phase-level power, voltage and power factor at ten-second intervals. The free CC BY 4.0 archive contains monthly CSV measurements and scripts for continuity checks, resampling, gap filling and deriving household load and grid exchange. Coverage supports residential energy simulations and comparisons with model-energyplus or model-system-advisor-model-sam. A caveat is that one household cannot represent national behaviour. The provider also warns that nearest-neighbour imputation works for short gaps but becomes ineffective for long gaps. Source metadata and processing descriptions were checked; the archive was not downloaded.
